acceptanceCriteria: Approved iPhone and Watch accessibility technologies can operate every applicable function.
No-surprise playback and hearing-safety rules hold across lifecycle, route, interruption, and failure events.
Failure injection and endurance tests demonstrate deterministic state and containment without data corruption.
Physical-device-only claims remain unverified until the user reviews the required evidence.
rationale: Accessibility, hearing safety, and failure containment are release-critical cross-cutting behavior.
testSteps: Run automated accessibility, state-machine, safety, and fault-injection suites.
Collect but do not self-verify physical-device, VoiceOver, listening, and endurance evidence.
